title: Rate Lock Commitment Deposit Collection and Disposition
content:
**Rule.** A Rate Lock Commitment whose deposit rate is above 0.000 requires a deposit equal to that rate of the loan amount at lock, rounded to the cent. The deposit must be received within the product's due period of business days after the lock date, by one of the product's accepted payment methods.

**Single disposition.** A deposit refund or forfeiture disposes only of a deposit whose collected entry has not already been credited, refunded or forfeited. This is read from the lock's deposit records, by the collected deposit entry concerned, before any disposition is booked.

**Dispositions.**

| Event | Disposition of the deposit |
|---|---|
| The loan closes under the lock | Credited on the Closing Disclosure |
| Larkspur denies the loan | Refunded in full to the original payment method |
| The borrower withdraws the file or cancels the lock | Forfeited |
| The lock expires and is not relocked within the relock window | Forfeited |

Every disposition names the collected deposit entry and carries its full amount. Partial refunds do not exist.

*Worked example (hypothetical figures):* with a deposit rate of 1.000 percent and a loan amount at lock of $512,345.00, the deposit is $5,123.45. If Larkspur later denies the loan, the refund is the full $5,123.45 to the original payment method. That collected entry can then not also be credited or forfeited.
